decisions.reason: As a multi-model safety shoe line close to the core business, it likely embodies meaningful development and marketing investment and supports the firm's publicly stated innovation path, so management would be inclined to continue it unless failure were unmistakable.

Although this seems narrower than the larger ranges, it still fits the established occupational footwear portfolio and innovation narrative, so sunk development effort and the ease of attributing weak uptake to temporary market factors make continued support more likely than withdrawal.

Because this is another multi-model safety shoe series at the center of the firm's established offer, with visible commitment and relevance to its future-footwear positioning, management would be reluctant to reverse course quickly.
